title: Release Ember 1.0.1 · Getterbetter/ember

content_html:
• Download Ember as a disk image: open it and drag Ember onto Applications.
  • Opened from Downloads, Ember now asks to be moved to Applications first. Run from there,
    macOS can't start its helper ("the helper didn't answer in time").
  • Uninstall now finishes: Ember quits and moves itself to the Bin. Before, it removed the
    helper and login item but then hung on quit.
  • The checksum file lists bare file names, so shasum -c works next to a download.
content_text: Download Ember as a disk image: open it and drag Ember onto Applications. Opened from Downloads, Ember now asks to be moved to Applications first. Run from there, macOS can't start its helper ("the helper didn't answer in time"). Uninstall now finishes: Ember quits and moves itself to the Bin. Before, it removed the helper and login item but then hung on quit. The checksum file lists bare file names, so shasum -c works next to a download.
